T: Sunday dinner. Every Sunday. No excuses.
D: A Chicago family is held together by their grandmother's weekly Sunday dinners.
P: Serve the mains when the whole family sits down for Sunday dinner at Big Mama's.
S: Halved eggs piped with a mayo, mustard and sweet relish filling, hot sauce, paprika

Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard, a spoon of sweet pickle relish and a dash of hot sauce, piped back, paprika on top. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp sweet relish and a dash of hot sauce. Pipe back and dust with paprika.
Big Mama's skillet cornbread, honey butter
the cornbread in the cast iron pan

Golden buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan so the edges crisp, cut in wedges with whipped honey butter. Put 20g butter in a 25cm cast iron pan and heat in a 220C oven for 10 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and half a tsp salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter until just combined. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt.
Big Mama's ham hock braised greens
Kale or collards braised for hours with smoked ham hock and garlic

Kale braised slowly with smoked ham hock, onion, garlic and chilli until silky, the meat picked back in, sharpened with cider vinegar and served with the pot liquor. Simmer a smoked ham hock in 1.5L water with a sliced onion, 3 garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes for 1 hour. Add 2 bunches kale or collards, stems removed and chopped, and braise gently for 90 minutes. Pick the meat off the hock and stir it back in. Finish with 2 tbsp cider vinegar and serve in bowls with plenty of the pot liquor.
M: Buttermilk brined chicken, double dredged and fried in cast iron
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried in a cast iron pan at 165C until 74C at the bone.
Big Mama's baked mac and cheese

Macaroni baked in a custard of eggs, evaporated milk and three cheeses until set, with a golden crust of sharp cheddar on top. Boil 500g macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain. Whisk 2 eggs with a 375ml tin of evaporated milk, 250ml milk, 60g melted butter, 1 tsp mustard powder, salt and pepper. Toss the pasta with 300g grated sharp cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, then the custard. Tip into a buttered dish, top with 100g more cheddar and bake at 180C for 40 minutes until set and golden.
W: Spiced cooked peaches under a soft biscuit topping
Peaches sliced and cooked with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg, a buttery biscuit topping sprinkled with sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Sweet black tea mixed with fresh lemonade

Strong black tea sweetened while hot and mixed half and half with fresh lemonade, poured over ice with lemon wheels and mint. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with a pinch of bicarb for 5 minutes. Stir in 80g sugar while hot and cool. Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80g sugar and 500ml cold water. Mix the tea and lemonade in a big jug with ice, lemon wheels and mint, and pour.

Pull the oyster mushrooms into large clusters and soak in the buttermilk and hot sauce in the fridge for 1 hour.
